images.alt: A burn falling through a gorge into a green glen, with bare hill summits beyond
A waterfall running down granite slabs into a clear pool ringed with pink boulders
A wide glen opening between rocky peaks, heather and grass in the foreground
Bog cotton blowing across a hillside with a waterfall in the distance
A green hillside dropping away into a glen, rock and fern in the foreground
A bare branch reaching over the mirror-still surface of a wooded loch
A small boat moored below the painted houses of Portree harbour, Isle of Skye
The painted houses of Portree reflected in still water, seen from the shore garden
